scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.start:extension: npm run build -w server && npm run start -w server
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.build:extension: npm run build:extension -w client && node scripts/package-extension.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
